sources.author: Swyx
sources.headline: Founder @ Latte Academy | Previously @Expedia @AWS
sources.post_summary: Discusses the evolution of AI agents from hype to practical deployment, highlighting key frameworks like LangGraph and AutoGen for building reliable agentic systems. Emphasizes the need for better developer tools to handle agent orchestration and error recovery in production environments.

sources.author: Andrej Karpathy
sources.headline: Founder @ Eureka Labs | ex-OpenAI, Tesla AI
sources.post_summary: Shares insights on scaling AI infrastructure for agent-based workflows, pointing out bottlenecks in current GPU clusters and the rise of distributed training tools. Predicts a shift towards agent-native infrastructure in the next year.

sources.author: Guillermo Rauch
sources.headline: CEO @ Vercel
sources.post_summary: Explores how next-gen developer tools are integrating AI agents for code automation, with examples from Vercel's edge runtime optimizations. Stresses the importance of seamless AI infra for full-stack developer productivity.

sources.author: Nat Friedman
sources.headline: Co-Founder @ GitHub (former)
sources.post_summary: Analyzes recent breakthroughs in open-source AI agent toolkits and their impact on automation pipelines. Recommends infrastructure setups using Kubernetes for multi-agent systems in dev environments.

sources.author: Addy Osmani
sources.headline: Engineering Leader @ Google Chrome
sources.post_summary: Details performance optimizations in browser-based AI agents using WebGPU, bridging developer tools with AI infra for client-side automation. Includes benchmarks showing 3x speedups in agent inference.

sources.author: Aakash Gupta
sources.headline: Founder @ Greptile | Ex-Head of Developer Relations @ Postman
sources.post_summary: Discusses building a GTM engineering function from scratch, emphasizing the integration of engineering with sales and marketing for faster product launches. Highlights key tools and processes for scalable outbound automation within GTM teams. Shares lessons from scaling to $10M ARR.

sources.author: Ankur Nagpal
sources.headline: Founder @ Carry1st | Previously @ Teachable
sources.post_summary: Outlines a revamped sales ops playbook for B2B SaaS, focusing on outbound automation to boost pipeline by 3x. Covers data-driven strategies for sales ops teams to align with revenue operations goals. Includes real metrics from implementation.

sources.author: Sarah Chen
sources.headline: Head of Revenue Operations @ Notion
sources.post_summary: Explores content strategy as a core pillar of modern GTM, with tactics for sales ops to leverage content in outbound sequences. Details how revops can measure content ROI tied to pipeline generation. Case study from Notion's growth phase.

sources.author: Kyle Coleman
sources.headline: VP of Sales Ops @ Gong.io
sources.post_summary: Breaks down revenue operations frameworks for high-growth startups, integrating outbound automation and GTM engineering. Provides actionable steps for sales ops leaders to reduce CAC through ops optimization. Backed by Gong data insights.

sources.author: Lara Hogan
sources.headline: VP of Engineering @ Amplitude
sources.post_summary: Shares engineering-led approaches to GTM, including building internal tools for content strategy and outbound at scale. Discusses cross-functional revops challenges and solutions for sales alignment.

sources.author: Pieter Levels
sources.headline: Indie Maker & Founder of Nomad List, Remote OK
sources.post_summary: Pieter shared his latest product launch, a new tool for remote workers built entirely solo in a week. He detailed the tech stack, challenges faced during development, and initial user feedback. Emphasizes shipping fast over perfection in building in public.

sources.author: Arvid Kahl
sources.headline: Serial Entrepreneur, Author of The Embedded Entrepreneur
sources.post_summary: Arvid recounted pivoting from corporate job to bootstrapped SaaS founder, shipping his first product FeedbackPanda. He outlined lessons on solo development, customer interviews, and scaling without VC. Highlights the power of building in public for accountability.

sources.author: KP (Karthik Puduppakkam)
sources.headline: Founder of Lenny's Newsletter
sources.post_summary: KP discussed his journey shipping multiple products as a solo builder, from newsletters to tools. Shared metrics on launches, iteration based on public feedback, and balancing full-time work. Stresses transparency in building in public to attract users.

sources.author: Sahil Lavingia
sources.headline: Founder & CEO of Gumroad
sources.post_summary: Sahil shared a career pivot story from Pinterest to starting Gumroad solo, shipping the MVP in weeks. Detailed failures, pivots, and growth through public updates. Advocates for builders to document their journeys openly.

sources.author: Daniel Vassallo
sources.headline: Ex-AWS, Indie Maker & Writer
sources.post_summary: Daniel posted about leaving Big Tech for solo building, shipping small products like OnePageCRM. Covered revenue numbers, dev process, and advice for career pivots into indie hacking. Fully transparent with public dashboards.
